summary: The Treasure Chest of Courage is an ANTHOLOGY, and nine of its ten rows have no forward position. Sixteen of its seventeen segments are either tankobon 描き下ろし bonus chapters — which are the source (published inside the volume by Toka, the GTO/Toroko rule) but carry no number in the manga's own 第N話 numbering — or anime-original vignettes filling gaps the 2021-22 TV series left; both are A44 position-less, so rows 1-9 are delivered as anchor_hostile with the chapter map and side_story annotations rather than as numbers. The one exception is the finale: 第十話「剣王の復活」 adapts the OPENING OF THE MANGA'S PART TWO — ousamaranking.fandom's Chapter 156-161 summaries match it beat for beat (Desha in the Divine Treasure Vault, the cursed swords, the demon child, Despa fishing Ouken's head out of the lake, Ouken human again, Desha's connection going dead), with ch 157's Kuhya-inn scene moved to the episode's close. So the stored MU pin is wrong twice over: 'Vol 12, Chap 155 (S1)' is literally labelled S1, is the last chapter of part one, and is the 2021-22 series' endpoint, not this entry's (G37) — and it also UNDER-states this entry, which reaches at least ch 161 in volume 13. END 161 is delivered as a verified floor at medium confidence: the finale's last act (Ouken storming the vault, the god he kills, Desha's cape and crown) runs on into ch 162+, and no readable source summarises 162-167 chapter by chapter. Identity is also delivered: all ten rows were bare, and title + air date now rest on ja-WP, en-WP, syobocal TID 6691 and the official site's per-episode STORY pages.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 156-161 (vol 13, the opening of the manga's part two); the episode's closing act (Ouken at the Divine Treasure Vault) carries on into ch 162+ of the same volume, chapter boundary unverified
anchors.note: A4/A10. The only row in the run that carries first-time MAINLINE pages. START = 156 (the episode opens on ch 156's first pages: Bojji and Kage on the wagon passing the ruined Desha), not a sliver. END 161 is a VERIFIED floor, not a ceiling — see the end_chapter repair and flags_for_sean. Everything else in this anthology is tankobon bonus-chapter or anime-original material with no mainline position (A44).

continue_points.note: C5: resume at ch 162 (vol 13). Expect a SHORT OVERLAP — the finale's last act (Ouken storming the Divine Treasure Vault, the god he kills, Desha's abandoned cape and crown, and the report that Desha traded his memories) plays out over the chapters immediately after 161, and this verdict could not fix that boundary. Nothing later is animated: the anime never touches vol 13's remaining Bojji-and-Kage material in the Kuhya Kingdom, nor vol 14 (168-179 + bonus) onward, so ch 162 to the manga's current frontier is never-adapted.

anchor_hostile.why: A44 position-less: an anthology of tankobon 描き下ろし (draw-for-the-volume) bonus chapters, which carry NO chapter number in the manga's own numbering (MangaDex labels them N.5 as a scanlation convention; the 単話版 digital edition publishes only the numbered 第N話). Segment A カゲのおつかい is a Despa-training interlude (candidate: vol 5's bonus 'A Safe Haven', described by the fandom's manga page as 'an interlude during Bojji's training under Despa' — NOT confirmed); segment B 王子とお金 is the volume-8 bonus chapter (MangaDex 104.5, titled 'Inversion de Despa' / Despa's investment in the es-la release — the segment ends with Despa lending the poor girl money as an investment). Either way: no mainline chapter, no forward position (A1/A44).

A44 position-less: 荒野の獣 is the volume-6 描き下ろし bonus chapter (MangaDex vol 6 carries bonus 80.5), an interstitial set between the 2021 TV series' eps 11 and 12; ふしぎな砂漠 (the oasis and the regenerating beast on the road to the Bosse Kingdom) has no identified manga counterpart. Bonus chapters have no number in the source's numbering, so there is no END and no START (A44).

A44 position-less: ヒリングの旧友 fills the gap between Hiling and Dorshe's exile and their reunion with Anne — its antagonist ドドン is listed by ja-WP under アニメオリジナルのキャラクター (『いずれも勇気の宝箱に登場』), i.e. anime-original; ダイダと魔法 is a childhood vignette with no identified manga counterpart. No mainline chapter is adapted, so no anchor (A1/A44). See flags_for_sean — the canon/original split of this row is unresolved and NO type change is proposed.

A44 position-less: the episode adapts the volume-9 描き下ろし bonus chapter 'Immortality' (不死) — ousamaranking.fandom's Treasure Chest of Courage page names it from the teaser ('a flashback to Desha's revolution in the Underworld … adapted from the Volume 9 bonus chapter, "Immortality"'), its Volume 9 page lists 'Bonus Chapter, "Immortality"' after ch 117, its manga page describes that bonus chapter as 'a background chapter about the princes of the Underworld, and their revolution against their father, the god Satun' — exactly the official synopsis for 第四話 — and MangaDex's vol 9 carries the bonus as 117.5, titled 'Inmortalidad' in the es-la release. A bonus chapter is the SOURCE (it is published inside the tankobon by the author), but it has no mainline number, so it takes no anchor (A44); the annotation carries the mapping.

A44 position-less: three segments, none of them mainline. 冥府の掟 is built around フレン, whom ja-WP lists under アニメオリジナルのキャラクター; 恋する白馬 expands a one-line manga gag (Despa's horse Hakuou grew fat while he was away — ja-WP's 白王 entry); 優しき兵士ホクロ is Hokuro's backstory (candidate: the volume-7 bonus chapter, MangaDex 92.5, es-la 'Devocion inquebrantable' — NOT confirmed). No chapter number, no position.

A44 position-less: both segments are post-part-one epilogue vignettes (Bojji touring the town as king; Daida as king with Miranjo teaching the children — ja-WP notes Miranjo's teaching role only as 『勇気の宝箱』6話), and the segment's lost bird ピッピ is on ja-WP's アニメオリジナルのキャラクター list. No mainline chapter is adapted.

A44 position-less: 薄ら笑いの蛇使い adapts the volume-3 描き下ろし bonus chapter 「笑う門には福来る」 ('Those Who Smile Will Be Blessed With Good Fortune And Happiness') — the fandom's Volume 3 page lists it after ch 41, its manga page describes it as 'a flashback chapter about Bebin, and his path to the Big Four' (the official synopsis for the segment: young Bebin loses to Apeas and goes looking for a sword master), and its Treasure Chest page flags it from the teaser; MangaDex carries the vol-3 bonus as 41.5. 四天王の宴 is anime-original in at least its antagonist (チャンピオン is on ja-WP's アニメオリジナルのキャラクター list). Bonus chapters carry no mainline number (A44).

A44 position-less: カゲのあこがれ is Kage's childhood in the Bo Kingdom with his mother (candidate: the volume-10 描き下ろし, MangaDex 129.5, es-la 'Aspiracion' — あこがれ = yearning / aspiration; supported by dic.pixiv.net's article, which I could only read through search-engine excerpts, so treat as cross-check); 偉大な母 is Bosse's courtship of Sheena and Bojji's birth, which the fandom's manga page lists as 'Bonus Chapter 1 (untitled) — an expanded version of Bosse and Sheena's first meeting' in volume 1 (MangaDex 13.5). Both are bonus chapters: no mainline number, no position.

A44 position-less: ミランジョと魔神 is young Miranjo meeting the demon child in the forest (a prequel vignette to the Miranjo material the 2021 series already adapted from vol 11) and 王子と宝物 is Bojji's farewell-gift round on the day he abdicates — a coda that sits AFTER ch 155, the end of part one, and before ch 156. Neither carries a mainline chapter number in running order (A44); the second is an epilogue the manga does not number.

G37: the stored pin is ANOTHER ENTRY's frontier. MangaUpdates' coverage segment reads 'Vol 12, Chap 155 (S1) The Treasure Chest of Courage covers skipped content' — the label is literally '(S1)', i.e. the 2021-22 TV series' endpoint, and ch 155 / vol 12 is the last chapter of the manga's PART ONE (第一部 = 第1〜155話 / 第1〜12巻; 第二部 = 第156話〜 / 第13巻〜; the volume split is confirmed by MangaDex's aggregate, where vol 12 = 142-155 + bonus and vol 13 = 156-167 + bonus, and by our own stored boundary v13: 156-167). This entry's finale does not stop at 155: it adapts the OPENING of part two. ousamaranking.fandom's Chapter 156-161 summaries match ep 10 beat for beat — ch 156 the wagon and Desha entering the Divine Treasure Vault with the Ranking judge; ch 157 Kuhya Kingdom / the inn / Bojji entrusting his gold to Kage, and the cursed blood-drinking swords; ch 158 the speared corpse, the prison, the demon child, Despa and the Captain at the lake; ch 159 the rope, the catfish, Ouken whole again, Desha making his wish; ch 160 Ouken human, the rotting carcass, the lost connection to Desha; ch 161 Despa's flashback, the knights' report, Ouken riding to the treasury and seeing an armoured man. The delivered END is a VERIFIED FLOOR (A4): the episode's last act — Ouken beating the golem gatekeepers, the god fight, Desha's cape and crown — runs on into ch 162+ of the same volume, and no source I could read summarises 162-167 chapter by chapter (the fandom's chapter pages stop at 161). See flags_for_sean.

Follows the end_chapter repair: ch 156-161 are volume 13 (MangaDex aggregate vol 13 = 156-167 + bonus 167.5; ousamaranking.fandom's Volume 13 page lists Chapter 156 … Chapter 167 plus the bonus chapter 'Poise of the Poison Forest'; our own stored boundary already reads v13: 156-167). Volume 12 was the volume of MU's (S1) pin, not of this entry's finale.

CHAPTER SPACE. One space: the manga's own 第N話 numbering. 第一部 = ch 1-155 = volumes 1-12; 第二部 = ch 156- = volume 13 onward. MangaDex's aggregate for the series (id 7e2933d2-8587-4c0f-b69c-4233864b96a8) reproduces the tankobon exactly — vol 1 = 1-13, vol 12 = 142-155, vol 13 = 156-167, vol 14 = 168-179 — and every volume ends with a 描き下ろし (drawn-for-the-volume) BONUS chapter that the scanlations label N.5 (13.5, 27.5, 41.5, 55.5, 68.5, 80.5, 92.5, 104.5, 117.5, 129.5, 141.5, 155.5, 167.5, 180.5, 193.5, 205.5 …). Those .5 labels are NOT the source's numbering: the 単話版 digital edition (comic.k-manga / cmoa title 249627, 302 units) publishes only 第N話 units, and ja-WP names the bonus chapters by title alone ('コミックス14巻描き下ろし「冥府に迫る影」', 'コミックス15巻描き下ろしエピソード「盗賊首領 オヤーブ」') — which is exactly MangaDex's 180.5 ('Whereabouts of the Underworld' / 'La sombra se acerca al inframundo') and 193.5, confirming that the .5 units ARE the tankobon bonus chapters. A bonus chapter published inside the tankobon IS the source (the GTO/Toroko rule) — so these rows are not side_source; they are canon/side_story with NO mainline number, i.e. A44 position-less.
Our stored volume boundary v13: 156-167 agrees with MangaDex. Note also that the mainline has moved past our stored latest_known=276 (cmoa lists 302 単話版 units as of this research); that is a freshness fact for the manga row, not an edition difference.
